title: First-Run Ribbon & Checkpoint Heatmap — Console Onboarding Assets
creator: Lina Park
description: Goal: Design a compact first-run ribbon experience and a checkpoint heatmap component that surfaces onboarding progress, contextual tips, and empty-state actions across Console views. Deliver a suite of responsive visual assets, annotated screenshots for release notes, and finalized microcopy for engineering handoff. This ticket covers art direction, component variants (collapsed/expanded), color token usage for accessibility contrast, and a developer asset bundle (SVG/PNG/JSON annotations).
acceptance_criteria: Ribbon component has compact and expanded states with responsive breakpoints and exported SVGs
Checkpoint heatmap shows 0/1/2+ checkpoint states and hover annotations for each cell
Empty-state panels include primary CTA + secondary link and match console token styles
All microcopy has been reviewed by PM and localized placeholders are documented
Design handoff package uploaded to Drive and linked in PR for engineering implementation
comments: 2026-03-10 — Kickoff: aligned with PM on scope; agreed to prioritize collapsed ribbon for mobile first.
2026-03-11 — Design critique: reduced iconography in ribbon to avoid cognitive overload; PM requested clearer success state for checkpoints.
2026-03-11 — Accessibility review: adjusted color palette to meet 4.5:1 contrast for primary labels; added focus outlines for keyboard nav.
2026-03-12 — Engineering sync (Marco): confirmed ribbon animation budget and prefers CSS-driven transitions; ENG-12848 added as dependency for runtime flags.
2026-03-12 — Linking assets: Figma file and Drive handoff uploaded (see links below). Planning a short usability smoke test with 6 internal participants on 2026-03-16.
notes_for_engineering: Export SVGs with layer names preserved and a README describing token usage
Provide CSS variables for color tokens; include a no-JS fallback for the collapsed ribbon
Heatmap should support ARIA labels for each checkpoint cell and provide title/description for screen readers
qa_checklist: Ribbon toggles correctly at all breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px)
Heatmap cells reflect real progress states in staging data
Empty-state CTA opens correct onboarding modal and logs telemetry event 'onboarding.cta.click'
Microtips dismiss and persist state across sessions
